query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN olfactive_profile IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN olfactive_profile LIKE '[%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as json_array_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN olfactive_profile IS NOT NULL AND olfactive_profile NOT LIKE '[%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as plain_string_count
FROM molecules;
